title: Design review with proposals that are not decisions
covers: proposals and preferences that the meeting did not decide
a choice deferred to next week
thinking aloud that is not an action item

segments.speaker: Quinn Example
segments.text: Design review for the new reporting service.

segments.speaker: Taylor Example
segments.text: I propose we use Postgres 17 for the reporting store.

segments.speaker: Jamie Example
segments.text: I'd rather we benchmark it against the column store first.

segments.speaker: Quinn Example
segments.text: Let's not decide today. Benchmark both and decide next week.

segments.speaker: Taylor Example
segments.text: I'll run the benchmark on both by next Monday.

segments.speaker: Jamie Example
segments.text: Maybe we could also use a queue for ingestion, just thinking aloud.

segments.speaker: Quinn Example
segments.text: Interesting, write it up if you want, no commitment.

segments.speaker: Taylor Example
segments.text: One thing we do agree on: the reporting service gets its own database.

segments.speaker: Quinn Example
segments.text: Yes, that's decided, a separate database for reporting.

segments.speaker: Jamie Example
segments.text: What retention do the reports need? Nobody gave us a number.

decisions.text: The reporting service gets its own, separate database.
The reporting store choice is deferred to next week, after a benchmark.

actionItems.text: Benchmark Postgres 17 and the column store.

expected.text: RPT-2 Reporting store benchmark is in the backlog without an owner.
RPT-6 Report retention requirements is open and unassigned; retention is the agenda's third item.
